thesis: COLM is a genuine relative-strength name in a risk-off tape: it sits in a strong uptrend above its SMA20, SMA50 and SMA200 and within 1% of its 52-week high while QQQ is below both major averages. The Q3 earnings rebound is real (net income +63% YoY, free cash flow positive, low dilution risk), no earnings event falls inside the swing window, and apparel/consumer discretionary (XLY) is holding up. The setup is only a pullback entry, not a chase. RSI is overbought, reward/risk is about 1.5, and the regime is hostile, so this is a weak-to-moderate long that works only on a dip into the entry zone with the structural stop.
